title: A · 森间书桌｜温暖陪伴，点词即读
caption: 纸白与森林绿；轻量词卡，日常点读首选。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High-fidelity iPadOS app UI concept for SenLearn, direction A "森间书桌".
Primary request: Design ONE complete clean flat landscape tablet screenshot in a 4:3 aspect ratio. This is the reading-and-tap-to-pronounce page of a warm, refined, offline English-learning app. Show the actual app screen edge to edge; no device frame, no perspective, no desktop backdrop, no poster, no collage, no annotations outside the UI.
Product context: Users import PDF or photos, text recognition overlays provide pronunciation on tap. Core joy comes from original book illustrations and playful response to selected words. An uncluttered native iPad experience.
Composition: a slim top toolbar, a narrow left page-thumbnail rail, and an expansive central book page occupying over 60% of the total screen. Top left: a tiny tasteful sprout icon and the word SenLearn; then back chevron and Chinese label 返回书架. Top center: current document title Forest Friends and page count 3 / 12. Right of toolbar: a restrained segmented mode control with 点读 selected and 标注 unselected, and a minimal ellipsis icon.
Main canvas: a large warm white page with subtle paper texture and soft edge shadow, nearly full remaining height and width. On the upper part of the book page, an original small editorial children's illustration of a warm russet squirrel beside green woodland trees and one seed, no giant mascot. Use beautiful muted gouache-style illustration with ample clear space, arranged like a real picture book. On the lower middle of the page, large easy-to-read English serif text on two lines reading EXACTLY:
"The little squirrel lives in the forest."
"It finds a seed under a tree."
The word squirrel in the first sentence has a soft sage green rounded highlight. Closely adjacent to this highlighted word, a compact elevated definition card with a little pointer displays "squirrel", "松鼠", and a clear green circular play triangle followed by "听发音". It must visibly belong to the selected word and must not obscure other text.
Left narrow navigation: three realistic miniature page previews, current page bordered forest green and marked 3. Other visible page numbers 2 and 4. White space rather than heavy panel decoration.
Bottom: a compact floating audio playback bar in warm white with subtle shadow. It contains "听整页", previous-sentence icon, a prominent forest-green circular pause button indicating page playback, next-sentence icon, slim progress track, and "语速 0.8×". Controls have generous tap targets but no giant toolbar. The bar floats near the bottom edge without hiding page text.
Visual style: premium warm learning product, editorial and calm, precise real deployable UI proportions, friendly readable Chinese sans serif and a beautiful highly readable English book serif. Mostly paper white #F7F5ED, forest green #2C6250, sage #DCE8DC, a little apricot yellow in the illustration. Soft rounded corners, very restrained shadows, superb alignment, generous whitespace. Keep decor minimal, beautifully quiet. Chinese text should be accurate and sharply legible.
Constraints: Full single app screen, landscape approx 4:3, high fidelity, clean edges. No leaderboard, badges, points, rewards, course store, cloud sync, login, giant character, gradients, fake marketing headline, decorative title "森间书桌", watermarks, photography or device shell. The woodland illustration is inside the book content only; UI chrome stays calm.

title: B · 清透原生｜家长陪读，清晰分栏
caption: 蓝灰原生风格；辅助面板便于家长准备材料和陪读。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: High fidelity concept of one iPadOS reading-and-tap-to-speak screen for SenLearn, native iOS/iPadOS offline OCR reader.
Primary request: Create a single elegant practical flat app screenshot at landscape 4:3 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x1152. Direction B: clear native Apple reading tool, refined and serene, restrained system controls. This is a real buildable application screen, not a marketing dashboard. No device frame, perspective, collage, external labels, branding board or explanatory text outside the app.
Color palette: cool pale gray #F3F5F8 background, white panels and paper, native blue #2563EB accent, dark ink #202833. Very fine gray dividers, moderate native rounded corners, hairline symbols and lightweight toolbar. Large generous touch targets, crisply aligned typography.
Layout: full-width slim native top toolbar, left narrow 125px thumbnail navigation, center large original English picture-book page, right roughly 230px reading inspector. The original book page must be the clear visual focus and occupy more than half the screen. Slim clean native bottom audio bar.
Top toolbar: back chevron and label “书架” at far left, SenLearn wordmark and small leaf mark, centered segmented control with “点读” selected and “标注” unselected, search icon and ellipsis icon on right. Absolutely no account avatar, cloud syncing, shop, chatbot, test score, marketing metrics or task cards.
Left sidebar: small title “页面”, three vertically spaced miniature picture-book page thumbnails, discreet number 2 below the top thumbnail, number 3 under the selected center thumbnail surrounded by a blue keyline, number 4 under the bottom thumbnail; bottom caption “3 / 12”. Use coherent tiny foliage pictures on thumbnails.
Central white page with a soft fine shadow: generous margins, book title “Forest Friends” in beautiful readable English serif at top. Below title the exact text on two lines: “The little squirrel lives in the forest.” and “It finds a seed under a tree.” in large dark serif type, 30–36px scale. The word squirrel within the first sentence is precisely enclosed by a thin blue selection outline with very pale blue highlight; do not select any surrounding words. Under the sentences a large original watercolor picture-book illustration, squirrel with warm rust fur and fluffy tail near a fallen seed, gentle green trees and forest grass, soft ivory paper background, artistic and charming yet calming. A small page number 3 centered at book-page bottom.
Right inspector on white with hairline left divider: heading “阅读辅助”; small gray label “当前单词”; word “squirrel” in large bold sans serif, Chinese translation “松鼠” underneath; one prominent round blue speaker/play pronunciation button. Divider, segmented control “单词” selected and “整句” unselected. Below it row “慢速播放” with native blue toggle turned on; compact gray supporting text “轻点文字，即可听读”. Controls must feel highly organized, airy and native.
Bottom audio bar: play/pause circle on left, label “听整页”, thin progress line and small blue scrubber, speed “0.8×” on right, enough spacing and no excessive buttons. The bar aligns under the reading canvas.
Typography: SF Pro style UI sans serif and readable Chinese system font, English book text classy readable serif. Chinese labels must be accurate and unobtrusive. Flat straight-on pixel-sharp app screenshot. No glossy rendered tablet, no physical desk, no external annotations, no extra invented features.

title: C · 探索乐园｜大按钮，轻量趣味
caption: 奶油黄与珊瑚红；点读、整句、重听一眼可见。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High-fidelity iPad landscape application reading screen for SenLearn, design concept C "探索乐园". Generate ONE beautiful flat complete application screenshot, approximately 4:3 landscape, 1600x1200 if possible.
Primary request: A sophisticated friendly Chinese parent-child early-learning app that turns imported PDF/picture books into tappable pronunciation. This is the ACTUAL reading screen, not a marketing poster. Book page is the hero, taking over 55% of visual area.
Composition: Entire screen edge-to-edge, no device bezel, no perspective, no collage, no external headline. Warm cream #FFF8E8 canvas. Compact top navigation with back chevron and 返回 at left, SenLearn modest brand, center book name "Forest Friends", right "3 / 12". Below, a generous pale-white rounded paper book surface with a softly colored original hand-drawn forest illustration: one small squirrel, trees, one seed, soft tactile cut-paper quality. Artwork and book text form one coherent picture-book page. Use restrained, refined child-friendly character, high usability and abundant clear space.
Book page: Two LARGE beautiful readable English sentences, exactly:
"The little squirrel lives in the forest."
"It finds a seed under a tree."
The word "squirrel" is selected with a hand-drawn warm yellow oval/highlight. Immediately adjacent to selected word, a concise cream-white speech popup shows "squirrel", Chinese "松鼠", and a large obvious circular coral play triangle icon. Keep text unblocked.
Accessory: A single small paper-cut squirrel companion near an outside side margin of the reading page, less than 10% of the screen, with the exact short gentle prompt "点一点，听一听". This companion is secondary to the book. Three tiny leaf symbols indicate relaxed exploration progress, one filled warm yellow and two subtle outlines. No badges.
Reading controls: Small coherent segmented "点读" / "标注" control and "0.8×" speed control in reading toolbar, navigation page arrows on outer book edges. Bottom dedicated action dock with three very large thumb-friendly rounded buttons, each icon + exact text: "听单词", "听整句", "再听一次". First coral #EA7058, second cheerful sky blue #77B8E5, third warm yellow #F5C75A. Dark warm ink for legible text.
Visual system: premium editorial quality balanced with restrained playfulness, generous radii 20–28 px, tactile but subtle paper shapes, no glossy 3D, exceptionally clear typography hierarchy and very large touch targets. Warm dark ink, cream #FFF8E8, coral #EA7058, sky blue #77B8E5, yellow #F5C75A. Simple consistent rounded icon strokes. Native iPad feeling and realistically implementable app UI.
Text accuracy: English sentences verbatim, correctly spelled. Chinese controls accurately rendered and readable. Brand exactly "SenLearn".
Avoid: game lobby, dashboard, rankings, countdown, coins, points store, stacks of badges, over-decoration, excessive mascot, tiny text, purple gradients, marketing headlines, design presentation labels, device frame, phone mockup, perspective, photographic hands.

title: D · 月光共读｜安静陪伴，单句聚焦
caption: 深墨蓝外壳；保留原页颜色，减少周边刺激。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High-fidelity iPadOS app UI concept for SenLearn, direction D "月光共读".
Primary request: Design ONE complete clean flat landscape tablet screenshot with exact 4:3 aspect ratio. This is a calm nighttime shared-reading page for a child learning English together with a parent. A real deployable native iPad application, immersive and quiet. Show actual app screen edge to edge, no device frame, no perspective, no desktop backdrop, no poster, no collage, no annotations outside the app.
Product context: Users import a PDF or photo, tap recognized words for pronunciation, listen to a whole sentence or page. Original document colors must remain unchanged. Dark mode affects app chrome only, never inverts the imported book page.
Layout: A minimal deep ink blue #17262D application shell. Very slim top toolbar with tiny SenLearn brand at far left, a simple back arrow, centered document title "Forest Friends" and page count "3 / 12", and only one small ellipsis menu at right. All sidebars hidden. Generous quiet dark frame around a large centered warm white ORIGINAL COLOR picture-book page, which occupies more than 65% of screen area.
Book page: warm clear white paper with extremely subtle texture, a small tasteful original watercolor of a russet squirrel among woodland trees, one seed near its paws, on the upper half. Calm storybook illustration, no huge character, no UI decoration around it. Lower half contains two large, crisply legible lines of English in a refined readable serif. Exact words:
"The little squirrel lives in the forest."
"It finds a seed under a tree."
The entire first sentence has a VERY pale sage green rectangular rounded background highlight. Within that sentence the word "squirrel" also has a slightly darker sage outline, indicating current word. Beneath and close to that word a restrained compact pronunciation popover reads "squirrel", "松鼠", with a clearly visible triangular play icon. This card must not obscure any book text.
Playback controls: at the bottom, a single wide calm rounded bar, clearly separated from the book content. Muted deep blue slightly lighter than the background, fine clean outlines, pale mint #B6DCCE accents. Evenly spaced large accessible touch targets show previous-sentence icon and label "上一句", central large filled mint circular pause control with dark blue pause icon, repeat icon and "再听一次", next-sentence icon and "下一句", and a compact "语速 0.8×" setting. A small discreet segmented control "原页" / "聚焦" sits unobtrusively above or beside this bar, with 原页 selected. Clear hierarchy and excellent optical alignment. Main audio controls are visibly usable by children and parents.
Visual style: Quiet premium bedtime learning, understated native iPad app, refined typographic hierarchy, restrained corners and shadows, high contrast and excellent legibility. Deep ink blue #17262D only on application chrome, pale mint #B6DCCE active UI, white page with natural sage/russet watercolors. No photo backgrounds, no starfield, no big moon, no neon, no glowing effects, no gradients, no points, badges, leaderboards, cloud sync, login, course store, excessive tools, giant mascot or extra decorative headings. Do not write "月光共读" on the screen. No device shell, no poster or surrounding frame outside app.
Constraints: SINGLE landscape 4:3 complete iPad UI, flat front-on screenshot, original page stays light and naturally colored. Accurate Chinese labels, very crisp English. The emotional difference from ordinary daytime learning is quiet focus, hidden sidebars and a dark outer shell, not fantasy decorations.
